ns2:section.sectionText: This section is reserved for students who were in a C2M (Merit) section of Math 347; for secondary education students; and for Math majors who were previous participants in the Merit Workshop program. Please contact mathadvising@illinois.edu <mailto:mathadvising@illinois.edu> with name, netid, and UIN if you are in one of these groups and wish to register. This section only has Math 347 as a prerequisite, not Math 416. Students considering graduate school in Mathematics should strongly consider a different section.
